# jpeg-js 0.4.4 (vendored)

A pure-JavaScript JPEG decoder and encoder, shipped here so the image shrink works on any machine with
nothing installed. `decoder.cjs` and `encoder.cjs` are `lib/decoder.js` and `lib/encoder.js` from the npm
package **jpeg-js 0.4.4** (https://github.com/eugeneware/jpeg-js), byte for byte, renamed to `.cjs` so node
always loads them as CommonJS whatever the surrounding project declares. BSD-3-Clause — see `LICENSE`.

Package integrity (npm `dist.integrity`):
`sha512-WZzeDOEtTOBK4Mdsar0IqEU5sMr3vSV2RqkAIzUEV2BHnUfKGyswWFPFwK5EeDo93K3FohSHbLAjj0s1Wzd+dg==`

Used only by `../images.mjs`.
